sql: SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, AVG("riskmanagement"."breachcount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."compscore" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score
why: average of data breaches per dataflow (by flowlink)
(compliance posture score - risk score) / risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score per dataflow (by flowlink)

sql: SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink"  GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink", "dataflow"."chanproto" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of control effectiveness score from risk score
why: (control effectiveness score - risk score) / risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of control effectiveness score from risk score per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto

sql: SELECT AVG("riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."compscore") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."compscore")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement"
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of control effectiveness score from compliance posture score
why: average of risk score per all
(control effectiveness score - compliance posture score) / compliance posture score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of control effectiveness score from compliance posture score per all

sql: SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, AVG("riskmanagement"."nearmissnum") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."riskassess" - "riskmanagement"."ctrleff") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."ctrleff")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink"  GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink", "dataflow"."chanproto" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of risk score from control effectiveness score
why: average of near misses per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto
(risk score - control effectiveness score) / control effectiveness score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of risk score from control effectiveness score per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto

sql: SELECT "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, SUM("riskmanagement"."nearmissnum") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."compscore" - "riskmanagement"."ctrleff") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."ctrleff")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink" GROUP BY "dataflow"."chanproto"
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of compliance posture score from control effectiveness score
why: total of near misses per dataflow.chanproto (additive)
